predictions.justification: Workplace hierarchy-of-controls reasoning and Canadian public-health system structure are different topics with no material shared learner decision.
Both endpoints test depth-of-anesthesia monitoring; only the follow-up versus long-term-management stage wrapper differs.
Sampling-method selection and quality-improvement terminology concern separate concepts and independently unrelated decisions.
The endpoints reproduce the same opportunity record across every supplied semantic and metadata field.
History-taking and physical examination are separate independently scoreable components of dysmorphology assessment.
Both endpoints require recognizing aortic dissection; the differing diagnosis versus complication-stage wrapper does not change that decision.
Recognizing end-organ ischemia is a complication decision distinct from recognizing aortic dissection itself.
General HIV management reasoning and diagnosis of acute retroviral syndrome require different clinical knowledge and responses.
Recognizing volvulus and resuscitating an unstable patient are sequential but independently scoreable emergency decisions.
The registry endpoint specifies family-centred care and capacity-based authority within the benchmark's broader pediatric palliative-care considerations.
Tetanus prophylaxis is a preventive treatment decision, whereas traumatic-hand-injury triage is an assessment decision.
Depth-of-anesthesia monitoring is a specified component of the broader intraoperative monitoring-standards decision.
Selecting abdominal imaging and recognizing volvulus are different investigation and recognition decisions within the same workflow.
Interpreting classic volvulus imaging and identifying indications for urgent intervention are independently scoreable decisions.
Counselling about the self-limited viral course is a specified subdecision within the broader gastroenteritis management-counselling scope.
Recognizing ischemia, perforation, or peritonitis is distinct from deciding whether urgent decompression or surgery is indicated.
Assessing cardiovascular risk and target-organ damage is independently scoreable from establishing the diagnosis of hypertension.
